versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the face-swap-runcomfy skill for RunComfy.
- Enables face and character swapping in videos and images using the runcomfy CLI, with automatic route/model selection based on user intent (still vs. video, batch vs. single, etc.).
- Integrates multiple advanced models: Wan 2-2 Animate, Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro, Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, and FLUX Kontext Pro.
- Supports a broad range of triggers, including “face swap,” “deepfake,” “character swap,” and natural language prompts for identity substitution.
- Includes detailed consent and disclosure guidance regarding rights and responsible use.
